an5.175:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañca upāsakapatikiṭṭho ca.
an5.175:1.5: kotuhalamaṅgaliko hoti, maṅgalaṃ pacceti no kammaṃ.
an5.175:1.8: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañca upāsakapatikiṭṭho ca.
an5.175:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañca hoti upāsakapadumañca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañca:
an5.175:2.5: akotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, kammaṃ pacceti no maṅgalaṃ,
an5.175:2.8: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañca hoti upāsakapadumañca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañcāti.
